title: Maintain Reduced Work-Zone Speed Until Passing the Final Termination Sign (Even If No Workers Are Visible!)

no_head_on_same_lane.note: No oncoming vehicles in same lane; mirror panel shows a following car in reflection, not head-on.

no_rhd_cabin.note: Middle-left interior view shows left-hand drive with driver on left holding left-side wheel.

single_bulb_signal.note: No red-yellow-green traffic signal present; construction arrow board is not a traffic signal.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: All panels show driving on right with yellow line on left of lane and white edge line on right.

zero_text.note: All signs, arrow board, and plates are blank shapes with no letters or numbers visible.

scene_match.note: Shows sedan proceeding through orange-cone taper past final post then resuming on open highway.

result.summary: Five-panel highway sequence shows reduced-speed passage through ending work zone to open road with all visual rules satisfied.

teaching_correct.note: Correctly teaches holding reduced speed through termination taper before resuming pace.

result.what_i_see: Multi-panel comic of a dark sedan driving through a daylight highway work zone with orange delineators and arrow truck, then continuing onto open highway past the last cone.
